title: dam config check answer
description: What dam config check prints on standard output with --json or --toon when config.lua and secrets.lua both read in full. A file that does not read gives the error document instead.

config.description: The path of config.lua, or null when there is none.

secrets.description: The path of secrets.lua, beside config.lua, or null when there is none.

warnings.description: What dam says about the token tables: tokens left out or disabled, and why.
